sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: releasegroup-releases (and every other tableMode:'multi' page): an explicitly-uncollapsed CAA/EAA column cell silently re-collapsed on every filter keystroke (single-table pages were never affected). Root cause: WIP.1's fix forces _artBuildMultiRowArtCell()'s FIRST-BUILD branch on every filter/sort re-render, and that branch hardcoded the new cell to collapsed, ignoring the expandedCells map the rest of the collapse/expand system already consults. Fixed by making that branch look up expandedCells too.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: releasegroup-releases (and every other tableMode:'multi' page): a column filter typed against the CAA/EAA column's per-image type/comment text (e.g. "cassette case") always matched zero rows, even when a row genuinely had matching artwork. Root cause: renderGroupedTable() always inserts row.cloneNode(true) copies into the DOM, so the 'source' rows runFilter() matches against never received the async CAA/EAA enrichment applied to the live, rendered clone. Fixed by syncing each enriched image's search text back onto the source row via a new _artSyncSearchTextToSourceRow() helper.
